results.title: Quarterback Toa Fa'avae, defense shine in New Mexico's dominant win over UTEP
results.description: You heard it all week from coaches. The more reps Toa Fa’avae gets … “The more improvement he’ll show,” New Mexico head coach Jason Eck said Monday. In his second full start, the Lobos’ sophomore quarterback showed plenty — much to UTEP’s misfortune. Fa’avae completed 15 of 19 passes for 249 yards, three touchdowns and one interception as UNM thoroughly dismantled the Miners in a 61-7 win ...

results.title: Colorado State fires DC Tyson Summers after blowout loss to Oregon State
results.description: The Colorado State Rams removed defensive coordinator Tyson Summers from play-calling duties during Saturday’s 56-26 loss to the Oregon State Beavers, and head coach Jim Mora confirmed afterward that Summers was no longer with the program.
